omissions: Original architecture SVG and five GitHub/Azure screenshots are omitted: App installation list, permission update request, new-permission approval, workflow run result, and Container Apps execution history.

Personal GitHub owners and repositories, App and installation IDs, Azure subscription/tenant/client/principal identifiers, resource inventories, actual private IP ranges, deployed hostnames, local paths, and execution/log identifiers are not published.

Historical deployment logs, original response payloads, private source URLs, commit history, original archives, and the unmerged workflow patch are not distributed; operational findings are restated in English.
Obsolete publish-profile extraction and secret-registration commands are replaced by the actual managed-identity deployment approach.
Public-access enable/disable sequences for Key Vault and ACR are described as historical, security-sensitive choices rather than offered as recommended executable defaults.

Source claims of universally free idle infrastructure, universal 15,000-request GitHub App limits, complete isolation from internal-only mode, and a VNetPeering UDR next-hop command are corrected rather than repeated.
The sample's instance hostname response field and informal response text are omitted; dependency funding URLs are omitted without changing dependency resolution or integrity metadata.
